versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the update-cli-config skill.
- Allows users to view and modify Codex CLI configuration settings in ~/.cursor/cli-config.json.
- Supports editing settings such as permissions, approval mode, vim mode, display options, sandbox, subagent models, network, bedrock integration, attribution, and web fetch allowlist.
- Clarifies which fields should not be manually modified (e.g. version, model selection, cached state).
- Provides details on project-level overrides using .cursor/cli.json files.
